Package index

Data access

Download and refresh climate-index time series from authoritative providers.

get_index()
Download a single climate index
get_indices()
Download multiple climate indices
update_indices()
Update bundled package data

Index registry

Discover available indices and inspect their metadata.

list_indices()
List available climate indices
get_index_info()
Get detailed information about a climate index

Visualization

ggplot2 helpers tuned to anomaly time series, correlation matrices and availability charts.

plot_index()
Plot a single climate index
plot_indices()
Plot multiple climate indices
plot_correlation()
Plot correlation matrix of climate indices
plot_availability()
Plot data availability timeline
theme_climate()
Climate visualization theme
category_colors()
Category color palette

ggplot2 integration

Drop-in colour and fill scales aligned with positive/negative anomaly conventions.

scale_color_anomaly()
Anomaly color scale
scale_fill_anomaly()
Anomaly fill scale

Bundled datasets

Pre-bundled tibbles. Reproducible analyses pin to the package version; live analyses call update_indices().

climate_monthly
Monthly climate oscillation indices
climate_monthly_wide
Monthly climate indices in wide format
climate_daily
Daily climate oscillation indices
climate_mei
Multivariate ENSO index (MEI v2)
climate_metadata
Climate index metadata
climate_summary
Summary statistics for monthly climate indices
